599:t_027:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell is that huge thing!?」

599:t_027:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The $$ネオ・ジオング$$...! So they finished that, too!」

599:t_027:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「You've given it an anachronistic name...!」

599:t_028:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...!」

599:t_028:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I've seen your light, $$ガンダム$$s.」

599:t_028:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Light born within humans... Something with such warmth...! How futile...」

599:t_029:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I must act. That is my mission as a vessel.」

599:t_029:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$! The time has come to settle this!」

599:t_029:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, concentrate your attacks on that psycho-machine!」

599:t_029:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we stop him, the fighting will end! Let's do this!」

599:t_029:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll make this battle... the last battle among humanity!」

599:t_029:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel, king of the abandoned people, deserves the Box! You ignorant fools can't see that...! You're stains! I'll erase every last one of you...!」

599:t_030:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even if it halts humanity's progress, I will knowingly commit that folly.」

599:t_030:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Wait for me, $$オードリー$$... I will come back to you!)

599:t_030:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
(And I'll find the future... beyond this battle!)

599:t_031:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「My mission is not over yet!」

599:t_032:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you spread the fighting any further!」

599:t_033:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You've come, $$バナージ$$! I was waiting for you, who share my destiny as a vessel!」

599:t_033:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have seen many boys like you... boys who pilot $$ガンダム$$s and bring about miracles.」

599:t_033:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Miracles, too... repeat... And nothing changes.」

599:t_033:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$バナージ$$! I will show you the tears of time!」

599:t_034:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「Is that... what it means to understand each other?」

599:t_035:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...」

599:t_035:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So he, too... entrusted you with the future.」

599:t_037:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is gone now... Find your own way to live.」

599:t_038:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「All $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces have been destroyed or have withdrawn.」

599:t_038:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「There is no need to pursue them. With $$フル・フロンタル$$ defeated and most of its forces lost, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ cannot keep fighting.」

599:t_038:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「So it is over now.」

599:t_038:4.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... will be revealed.」

599:t_038:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I'm counting on you, $$オードリー$$.)

599:t_039:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Why!? Why am I losing!?」

599:t_039:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Why is it you!?」

599:t_039:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Why does the Colonel need you when you don't even want him to!?」

599:t_040:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't let it bother you, $$バナージ$$. Following $$フロンタル$$ to the very end was his own choice.」

599:t_040:2.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(See you, $$アンジェロ$$. If you're alive, this time you'd better find your own way to live, with your own strength.)

599:t_041:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「His heart remained with $$フロンタル$$ to the very end.」

599:t_041:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「A vessel to receive people's feelings... But relying on it will never let them move forward...」

599:t_042:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We have confirmed the destruction of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

599:t_042:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Not yet! As long as $$フル・フロンタル$$ hasn't appeared, the battle isn't over!」

599:t_042:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Stay alert! We still don't know what might happen!」

599:t_042:3.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(Hurry, $$バナージ$$... You and Princess $$ミネバ$$ hold the key to this battle.)

599:t_043:0.en:
$$ヒル$$
「The $$レウルーラ$$...! $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s flagship!!」

599:t_044:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So the $$レウルーラ$$ has fallen.」

599:t_044:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「But the fighting will not end until we defeat $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

599:t_044:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ジオン$$ has lost its original principles, ideals, and passion. It will perish along with that man...」

599:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「I've had enough of your selfish excuses! If we left Earth to you, our future would be pitch-black!」

599:t_100:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Darkness awaits humanity's future either way. Choosing a way to live peacefully within it is therefore the right choice.」

599:t_100:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Of course, a fearless child like you will see my words as mere excuses.」

599:t_100:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't act like a wise grown-up when you can't even convince one kid!」

599:t_100:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「There's no way I'll hand our future over to someone like that!」

599:t_101:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「We do not want a world built on resignation and compromise...!」

599:t_101:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then do you accept a world filled with despair and destruction?」

599:t_101:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「You are the one accepting that. We fight to prevent such a world.」

599:t_101:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You are an optimist who averts his eyes from reality... So the famed man of spirit is merely a romantic.」

599:t_101:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「For someone who would guide the world, you lack that sense of romance!」

599:t_101:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「A man like that cannot carry people's dreams and hopes!」

599:t_102:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I always thought you were strange, but I can't understand why you'd become the Empire's lackey!」

599:t_102:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is natural for a child. That is why you should listen to adults here.」

599:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That doesn't mean I think what you're saying is right!」
